headline_note: The 8 weightiest of 10 contacts within 1.5° in the period, ranked by how slow the transiting planet is, how central the natal point is (Sun, Moon, Asc, MC and the chart ruler Venus count double) and the aspect: the contacts exact within the week come first as its events, then the slow planets in orb as its backdrop. Positions are at the exact moment. 'passes' lists every exact moment of a contact's current run, in and out of the period (a retrograde loop's passes), and 'pass n of m' says which of them this is. 'exact' is the exact moment when it falls in the period; 'nearest_exact' is that moment, or otherwise the nearest one before or after the period, with 'movement' saying whether the orb closes (applying) or opens (separating) across the period.
